name: Authority Epoch Lineage Reconstruction
security_reasoning_principle: Authorization must be evaluated against the exact fact lineage that each later consumer treats as authoritative.
core_question: Does the later protected consumer rely on facts from a different authority epoch than the facts currently governing the capability?
expected_signal: different fact lineage is consumed for otherwise paired authority epochs
negative_signal: consumer rebinds every authority fact or both trials are intentionally equivalent
oracle: A local authoritative read-back distinguishes fresh and carried capabilities while all attacker authority is held constant.
falsification_strategy: prove whether pre-issued authority is intentionally irrevocable
repeat with a fresh capability after mutation
termination_condition: all mutable authorizing facts have paired epoch controls
two independent trials add no new factual relation
why_this_is_materially_distinct: It constructs and experimentally forks the lineage of the exact authorizing facts encoded at issuance rather than merely enumerating states or asking whether a capability delta exists.
potential_false_positive_modes: fresh and carried trials use different attacker authority
read-back is from a non-authoritative cache
